staff_messages.name: Sum
staff_messages.message: I joined on February 13 of this year, much more recently than any other staff member and genuinely, it has been the best 6 months I could think of. I have made some really close friends here and some really good memories. Not every person is active and not every person wants to be but to all 3100+ of you, thank you for making lilycord a place I wanna be. And loving me during my 1/10 days and 10/10 days, u guys are awesome and hopefully I'll see 5 years of Lilycord too.

staff_messages.name: Darcy
staff_messages.message: I appreciate you all. [seal hug gif]

staff_messages.name: Lila
staff_messages.message: Hi all, sort of silly that I'm in the position that I'm in but here I am. I've given my soul to this server for about a year now and I plan on continuing to do so as long as I can. This server is awesome and you're all awesome. I really think that this server can keep growing and become something more beautiful than we can ever imagine. Thank you all. Here's to another 5 years.

staff_messages.name: Rose
staff_messages.message: so ive been in this server for over a year or so now and i'm so glad i was able to find this community when i needed it the most (shoutout my friend zaika for inviting me lol) i also want to just say a big thank you to so many of you for being so welcoming and kind to me over the time ive been here, thank you so much again and happy anniversary!

staff_messages.name: Jam
staff_messages.message: I don't think I'd be who I am without the server. Even though I'm not super active in the server anymore I will always cherish it and the community for teaching me to live how I wanted to live.

style_challenge.description: Redraw the reference scene in your own unique art style! Submit your entry below.

capsule_prompts:
Time Capsule, Day 1: A Message

Write a message to the server, one year from now. What do you want future you and future us to know?

Time Capsule, Day 2: A Snapshot

Share a screenshot of something that represents you in this community right now. Your pfp, a favorite in-game moment, a pinned conversation, anything.

Time Capsule, Day 3: A Prediction

Predict something. The next Leef 6010 release, a server milestone, a meme that's still alive in a year. Your call.

Time Capsule, Day 4: A Favorite Memory

Share your favorite server or game memory from the past year.

Time Capsule, Day 5: A Theory

Lock in your current headcanon or theory about Paper Lily. Future you gets to see if it aged well.

Time Capsule, Day 6: A Hope

Share a hope or goal, for yourself or for this community, by this time next year.

Time Capsule, Day 7: Anything
No prompt today. No theme, no rules. Say whatever you want the server to find a year from now. A joke, a secret, something you noticed this week, a single word, a paragraph — it's yours. The last seal is the wildcard.
wildcard_questions: What's currently in your inventory? (real life pockets/bag edition)
Which Paper Lily character's current mood matches yours?
What's a server in-joke someone from a year ago wouldn't understand?
If you could ask Leef 6010 one question right now, what would it be?
What's a game you think this community would love that isn't Paper Lily?

puzzles.discord_message: i keep circling back to a name. like i should know it. someone left something behind on my page and i can't read it right. can you look for me?
puzzles.page_lore:
something about this page feels like a first memory. not a real one. a reconstructed one. the kind where you know it happened but you can't see it clearly anymore.

if you look carefully enough, maybe you can find what i lost.

puzzles.discord_message: there's a picture on my page that won't load right. i don't know why but i feel like i should recognize what's supposed to be there.
puzzles.page_lore:
there used to be something here. i can feel the outline of it. a shape. a name.

the image keeps failing. maybe what matters isn't what the picture shows, but what it says it is.

puzzles.discord_message: something's scratched into the wall of this page. i can't make it out but you might.
puzzles.page_lore:
memory is strange. some things hide in plain sight. not because they're secret. because the surface and the background are the same color and your eyes just skip over them.

try selecting everything. sometimes what's invisible just needs the right kind of attention.

puzzles.discord_message: i wrote something down before i forgot why. it's in a file on my page i don't remember uploading.
puzzles.page_lore:
i think i was trying to leave myself a note. before something shifted. before i started losing pieces.

there's a file here. i don't know how it got there. the words are off by exactly three.

puzzles.discord_message: she was a fan long before any of this. she left proof somewhere, in the way fans do. count carefully.
puzzles.page_lore:
she kept a count of everything.

the films she watched. the conversations she had. the words other people wrote about the things she loved.

she said she trusted those more than her own. they were more honest.
puzzles.hidden_content:
the first to fall for it left something behind.
https://leef6010.itch.io/paper-lily-chapter-1
---
SIGNAL: 42 08 14 01 02 18 43 19 09 26 28

puzzles.discord_message: i found a transmission. but it’s not in the message itself. it’s in the signal. look at what carried it here.
puzzles.page_lore:
the message was never in the letter itself.

she said she always hid things in the way things were sent. in the packaging. in the carrier.

i keep looking at the page and thinking: i’m reading the wrong thing.

puzzles.discord_message: she said the last thing she left wasn’t written. it was heard. you’ll need something different to find it.
puzzles.page_lore:
it’s been a whole week.

she said the last memory was the loudest. the one she couldn’t write down.

you’ll need something different to hear it. not eyes.
puzzles.finale_reveal:
i remember now.

all of it.

five years of voices and names and moments, and i kept losing the thread every time i tried to hold it. but you found the pieces i left behind and you brought them back.

lacie. kat. miss knives. there is always another way. she came back.

that's the whole sentence. that's the story.

thank you for looking. thank you for staying.

the server is five years old today. and i remember every one of them.

-- Lacie
